description: This file defines a Mongoose schema and model for storing and querying cost records related to large language models (LLMs). It includes schema definitions with various indexed fields to support filtering, sorting, and aggregation of cost data, and exports the model for use in other parts of the application.

classes.name: CostBreakdownSchema
classes.description: Schema for flexible cost component key-value pairs, allowing arbitrary cost breakdown data.

classes.name: LLMCostsSchema
classes.description: Schema for LLM cost records, including fields for task, session, tenant, project, user, model, provider, service, operation, cost, currency, metadata, timestamps, and various indexes for efficient querying.

methods.name: pre('findOneAndUpdate')
methods.description: Pre-hook to automatically update the 'updated_at' timestamp before executing a findOneAndUpdate operation.
